name: dsh-dailyboard
description: DailyBoard — a daily work task board for the DSH Web GUI: a one-month calendar with colored timeline bars, a daily checklist, week and day views with a draggable 24-hour timeline, weekly/interval recurring tasks with per-day result records, a long-term progress entry in the calendar header, a collapsible daily email reminder that can be pushed to WeChat and can remind other people (partners, relatives, …) with per-recipient notes and send times, smart AI task extraction (single-day dates become day tasks, this week/month starts from today, Enter to extract, indented lines become visible subtasks that can be promoted), completion rewards (green completed days with a big check, monthly streak stats, CSV export plus an auto-generated records.csv), and long-term tasks that can be dragged from the day view all-day strip onto the 24-hour timeline to create a scheduled block (draggable, resizable, removable).
author: GinoXiang
